author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the possibility of life behind bars for D4vd. It's been seven months since a body was found in the trunk of a Tesla sitting in Hollywood. Finally the cops decided to kick in the door of the long suspected D4vd and finally charge him. How did this all happen? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: D4vd Might Get the Death Penalty...
